parameters.name: ArtifactType
parameters.description:
The type of the artifact.

*   `ACCELERATED_IMAGE`: accelerated images.

parameters.name: ScopeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the effective range of the rule.

*   Set the value to the ID of the image repository.

parameters.name: ScopeType
parameters.description:
The effective range of the rule. Valid values:

*   `REPOSITORY`

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-artifact-build-rule --instance-id cri-cxreylqvcyje0000 --scope-type REPOSITORY --scope-id crr-pmajihou6cg00000 --artifact-type ACCELERATED_IMAGE --region cn-hangzhou
